explanation: Winners took home a silver medal and an olive branch, and runners-up copper or bronze. The gold, silver and bronze pattern began at St Louis in 1904.

claims.text: Winners at the 1896 Athens Olympics received a silver medal and an olive branch.
Winners in 1896 did not receive gold medals, bronze medals or cash prizes; runners-up received copper or bronze medals.
The practice of awarding gold, silver and bronze medals for first, second and third place began at the 1904 St Louis Olympics.
